definitions.explanation: A state of being emotionally controlled and not affected by excitement, anger, or panic; level-headedness.

examples.japanese: {冷静|れいせい}に{考|かんが}えてください。
{彼|かれ}はいつも{冷静|れいせい}だ。
{事故|じこ}が{起|お}きても、{冷静|れいせい}さを{保|たも}つことが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Even when an accident happens, it's important to maintain composure.
examples.notes: 冷静さ = calmness (noun form with さ)

notes:
USAGE: {冷静|れいせい} describes the quality of staying calm and thinking clearly, especially in stressful situations.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{冷静|れいせい}に{考|かんが}える (to think calmly)
・{冷静|れいせい}に{判断|はんだん}する (to judge calmly)
・{冷静|れいせい}さを{保|たも}つ/{失|うしな}う (to maintain/lose composure)
・{冷静|れいせい}な{判断|はんだん} (calm judgment)

CONTRAST:
・{冷静|れいせい} - emotionally calm, cool-headed
・{静|しず}か - physically quiet, peaceful
